file_stem: RWB E1 049 OCR pipeline on the Workbench document hub
title: OCR pipeline on the Workbench document hub
goal: OCR every inbound scan into Thai and English text, and ask for same-day rescans
why: Documents become searchable and classifiable. Only malware-clean files are read; pages below 0.70 quality go back to the case owner for a rescan.
ace_note: No ACE read. OCR works on files in the Workbench document hub.

writes.note: one row per page of OCR text

reads.note: who to ask for a rescan

stores: OCR JSON at ocr/{intakeId}.json in the standard container; OCR service (Autonomous Ops); ACE notification path
rules: BR1: read every file in Thai and English
BR3: OCR runs only after the malware scan is CLEAN
BR4: below 0.70 -> rescan; the threshold is inclusive
BR6: an item read once is not read again
risks: Page below the threshold -> RESCAN, owner told (MSG-P5-018)
OCR timeout or error -> stays PENDING; alert after 2 failed runs
3 attempts used or file will not open -> FAILED, UNREADABLE_FILE, review queue
example: 180 synthetic documents (30 x 6 types) all reach DONE or RESCAN with document_text rows
500 pages in 125 items finish in under 60 minutes with 4 workers
